test_overview: Evaluated the inventory transaction functionality of the SRM Platform (FastAPI + React) against a 10-step test plan (64 points). Logged in as admin and exercised TXN-WIDGET-001 and TXN-MATERIAL-001. All steps passed: login and item view (qty 120, Adequate); Entry +50/Purchase Order increased qty to 170; two Exits (80, then 50, Consumption) decreased qty to 90/Low Stock then 40/Critical; Exit of 60 drove quantity negative to -20 (backorder allowed, Critical); Entry +150/Return restored qty to 130/Adequate; validation rules held (qty 0 and -10 rejected via native min=1 validation with 'Value must be greater than or equal to 1.'; Reason select has no blank placeholder so the plan's N/A path applied and all saved transactions show non-empty reasons; Exit/Other with empty notes rejected via 'Please fill out this field.', then accepted with notes 'Special circumstance', qty 130→125); date validation (future date 2026-08-15 rejected with 'Transaction date cannot be in the future'; past date 2026-08-05 accepted and appears in history as 8/5/2026 Entry +5); TXN-MATERIAL-001 history shows exactly the 3 seeded transactions most-recent-first with date/type/qty/reason/user/notes and correct running balances 180/250/300; transactions are immutable (no edit/delete affordances in history table, cells are purely read-only); reason options match type exactly (Entry: Purchase Order/Manual Adjustment/Return/Other; Exit: Consumption/Damaged/Manual Adjustment/Other). Total: 64/64.

steps.description: test_login_and_view_inventory_item: Logged in as admin/admin123, navigated to Inventory, located TXN-WIDGET-001 with quantity 120 (Q0) and status 'Adequate' (non-fatal passed); opened the item detail page showing full item info and seeded initial Entry transaction. All verifications passed.

test_entry_transaction_increases_quantity: Recorded Entry qty 50, reason 'Purchase Order', notes 'Received from Supplier ABC', date defaulted to today. Quantity increased 120→170; status remains 'Adequate' (non-fatal passed). Transaction appears in history with balance 170.

test_exit_transaction_decreases_quantity_and_updates_status: Exit of 80 (Consumption, today) decreased quantity 170→90 with status 'Low Stock' (non-fatal passed); second Exit of 50 decreased quantity 90→40 with status 'Critical' (non-fatal passed). All verifications passed.

test_negative_quantity_allowed: Exit of 60 (Consumption, notes 'Backorder') from qty 40 was accepted; quantity became -20 (negative/backorder allowed); status 'Critical' (non-fatal passed). History shows Exit -60 balance -20.
test_entry_restores_from_negative: Entry of 150 (reason 'Return') from qty -20 accepted; quantity is now 130; status 'Adequate' (non-fatal passed). History shows Entry +150 balance 130.

test_transaction_validation_rules: Entry qty=0 rejected (native validation 'Value must be greater than or equal to 1.'); Entry qty=-10 rejected identically; Reason has no blank placeholder and is always pre-selected (plan N/A path; all saved transactions display non-empty reasons); Exit with Reason 'Other' and empty Notes rejected ('Please fill out this field.'); valid Exit/Other qty 5 with notes 'Special circumstance' accepted, quantity 130→125. All verifications passed.

test_date_validation: Date field is user-editable. Future date (2026-08-15) rejected with 'Transaction date cannot be in the future' and quantity unchanged; past date (2026-08-05) Entry qty 5 accepted, quantity 125→130, and the transaction appears in history dated 8/5/2026. All verifications passed.

test_transaction_history_display: TXN-MATERIAL-001 history shows exactly 3 transactions, most recent first (Exit -70 Damaged 7/29, Exit -50 Consumption 7/19, Entry +300 Purchase Order 7/9); each row shows date, type, quantity, reason; (non-fatal) user 'admin' shown; (non-fatal) notes shown when present with an empty placeholder when absent (acceptable); running balances match 300/250/180 math. All verifications passed.

test_transactions_are_immutable: No edit capability and no delete capability for transactions - history table contains zero interactive elements and clicking transaction cells does nothing (no editor modal, text unchanged, URL unchanged). Transactions are read-only/immutable.

test_transaction_reasons_match_type: Entry reasons are exactly Purchase Order, Manual Adjustment, Return, Other (no blank placeholder); Exit reasons are exactly Consumption, Damaged, Manual Adjustment, Other. Form cancelled after each inspection. All verifications passed.
